A.description: Straight pop/rock groove: kick on 1 & 3, snare on 2 & 4, 8th-note hats, snare-roll fill at section ends.

B.description: Syncopated: kicks on 1, 2.5, 3.5, clap layered on the snare, 16th-note hats with accents, open hat on 4.5.

C.description: Half-time: kick on 1 with a ghost kick, snare on 3, rim on 4.5, 8th hats plus a humanised 16th shaker.

A.description: Long root notes (whole/half), octave drop every 4th bar — warm, leaves room for the vocal.

B.description: Driving 8th-note pulse with a rest on the '2-and' and an octave jump on '4-and'.

C.description: Syncopated root–fifth pattern with a chromatic approach note into the next chord.

how_to_choose: Listen to *_preview.mp3, then write human_decisions.json (see skill schema) with drums.choice, bass.choice and bridge.choice, and re-run: pipeline.py <track> --from arrange. For NOTE EDITS use the index fields in 04_edits/midi/new_notes.json (written by that run) — the indices in this folder belong to the 8-bar audition only. Drum edits can also be addressed by bar+beat+inst via action 'remove_at', which survives re-renders.
